A simple cycle diagram showing the two-way flow of agricultural extension. At the top, a building. An arrow points right and down to a person with a clipboard, and continues down to a group of farmers in a field. This represents "New technologies and ideas". Another arrow points back up from the farmers, through the extension agent, and back to the researchers. This represents "Farmers' problems and feedback".

A scene of a Method Demonstration on a farm. An extension agent in a green shirt and boots is standing in front of five farmers. The agent is holding a knapsack sprayer and pointing to the nozzle, showing the farmers how to adjust it. The farmers are watching closely. A small table beside the agent holds a bottle of safe, organic pesticide and a measuring cup.
